notes: MADToken is the fixed-supply ERC-20 for the Mutually Assured Destruction playground. Its parameterless constructor mints 1,000,000,000 MAD with 18 decimals once to msg.sender, the factory in the launch flow. Transfers have no token-level fees or burns. There are no administrative powers, externally callable mint or burn functions, or application contracts. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the token supply.
